title: Complete n8n workflow
caption: Actual successful editor run. All 11 nodes connect, with 3 exception, 1 routine and 2 review items.

title: API intake configuration
caption: GET /intake supplies six fictional email records, including subject and body.

title: One email per workflow item
caption: Split Out maps the messages array into six individual supplier email records.

title: Custom AI system prompt
caption: The actual Prepare AI Request node defines extraction rules and treats email text as untrusted data.

title: Email content mapped into the LLM request
caption: Each email becomes JSON.stringify(item.json). The request includes the model, JSON Schema and system prompt.

title: Ollama HTTP configuration
caption: POST /api/chat sends $json.request to Qwen2.5 3B and returns the actual structured response.

title: AI response and source mapping
caption: The Code node pairs the source record with message.content. The validator parses and checks that JSON.

title: Validation and SQLite write request
caption: POST /record sends $json. The separate ledger service validates and stores the result before returning its route.

title: Mapped payload for SQLite storage
caption: The HTTP body maps the complete $json source and AI payload into /record. The response confirms created: true.

title: Exception condition and execution
caption: Native Switch compares $json.route with exception. Its Exception output contains three actual records.

title: Routine Log condition and execution
caption: Native Switch compares $json.route with logged. Its Routine Log output contains SUP-002.

title: Manual Review condition and execution
caption: Native Switch compares $json.route with manual_review. Missing or conflicting dates produce two review items.

title: SQLite service configuration
caption: The ledger container sets LEDGER_DB to /data/ledger-review.sqlite. SQLite storage runs in this service.

title: SQLite persisted CLI-run records
caption: Read-only SQL from the earlier CLI revision shows 2 exceptions, 1 routine log and 3 review records.

title: Controlled LLM outage execution
caption: The actual editor run continues through the failed LLM call and routes one item to Manual Review.

title: Controlled outage configuration and error
caption: The test deliberately calls closed port 1. Continue-on-error passes the failure to validation.

title: Stored outage review result
caption: FAILURE-001 reaches Manual Review with llm_unavailable. The workflow completes and stores the record.
